about_the_game:
Rally-style racing with a grappling hook. Yes.

A CAR WITH A GRAPPLING HOOK

Use your car's grappling hook on nearby buildings, pillars, towers (whatever you can find, really), to twist and turn around tight tracks, pulling amounts of G-force that make F1 look like a stroll in the park.

Accelerate, break, turn, and grapple left or right, charging up a handy boost the longer you hold the grapple.

Twist, swing, and boost.

HAND-CRAFTED TRACKS AND ENVIRONMENTS

Each track is made with tons of unique details and shortcuts. Well-thought-out layouts with interesting curve flow that explore the previously untapped potential of a car with a grappling hook!

BEAT THE CLOCK, THEN BEAT YOURSELF

Your main opponent in Grapple Car is yourself! (and the people above you in the online leaderboard).

Every track has 3 time goals: Bronze, Silver, and Gold. Hitting them earns upgrade points to improve your car’s handling and speed.

After beating the preset times, the player is now eligible to participate in the online leaderboard for that track, where the best of the best race it out to find the most optimal routes and builds.

A SOLO DEV PROJECT

Grapple car is a passion project mostly developed by a single person (me), so expect bold visuals and gameplay, accompanied by a unique charm/wackiness only possible when dealing with a car with a grappling hook.

WISHLIST

If you like what you see, wishlist the game and stay updated on its development! Lot's of exciting stuff is coming soon, so stay tuned 👀
